skills.chain: A causal chain with every link: the action, the market it hits, the rate, spending, AD, then output and the price level
skills.tool: The right policy tool for the framework named (an administered rate with ample reserves; an open market operation with limited reserves)
skills.graph: The right curve on the right graph, shifted the right way, with the new equilibrium compared with the old
skills.multiplier: The change that closes a gap: the direction first, then the gap divided by the right multiplier
skills.selfadjust: Long-run self-adjustment with its cause: nominal wages and input prices adjust, so SRAS shifts
skills.currency: A currency market read the right way round: the price in units of the other currency, the curve that moves and why
skills.calculate: A calculation with the formula or steps shown, not the answer alone
skills.identify: An explicit statement of the concept, rate or outcome asked for
